themes_detail.label: Rodent Crisis Erupts
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints spiked to 7 THIS WEEK, a 409% increase over the 8-week average of 1.4 weekly complaints (z-score: 5.67), signaling a potential infestation wave across Queens Village/Cambria Heights that demands immediate pest control investigation.
evidence: 7 rodent complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (409% spike)
Z-score of 5.67 indicates statistically significant deviation from baseline
High-severity classification suggests potential public health risk
reporting_angles: Interview residents in affected blocks to identify hotspots and timeline of infestations
Contact NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to assess whether they've detected unusual activity in the district

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Deteriorating Rapidly
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street signs jumped to 10 complaints THIS WEEK (300% above the 2.5 weekly average, z-score: 4.52) and curb condition complaints hit 5 THIS WEEK (700% above 0.6 weekly average, z-score: 6.29), suggesting accelerating street infrastructure failure across the district.
evidence: Street Sign - Dangling: 10 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly average (300% spike, z-score: 4.52)
Curb Condition: 5 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 6.29)
Community board has repeatedly requested street reconstruction funding from DOT—this spike may validate that need
reporting_angles: Photograph and map the most dangerous dangling signs and curb damage locations for visual storytelling
Query whether DOT has deferred maintenance schedules for Queens Village; cross-check with recent budget cuts

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions Spiking
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints surged to 30 two weeks ago, a 164% increase over the 11.4 weekly average (z-score: 4.55), indicating a potential sanitation crisis that may be linked to concurrent rodent and pest spikes.
evidence: 30 unsanitary condition complaints two weeks ago vs. 11.4 weekly average (164% spike, z-score: 4.55)
Temporal correlation: unsanitary spike occurred around same time as rodent spike, suggesting linked issue
Hazardous Materials complaints also UP 540% last week (4 vs. 0.6 average), indicating broader sanitation concerns
reporting_angles: Interview Sanitation Department about whether trash collection or street cleaning schedules have been disrupted
Document specific blocks where unsanitary conditions and rodents are co-occurring to establish causation

themes_detail.label: Damaged Tree Emergency
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints hit 62 two weeks ago, a 464% spike over the 11.0 weekly average (z-score: 5.31), suggesting storm damage, disease, or deferred maintenance across the district's tree canopy.
evidence: 62 damaged tree complaints two weeks ago vs. 11.0 weekly average (464% spike, z-score: 5.31)
Community board has repeatedly requested park maintenance and amenity upgrades—this spike validates systemic neglect
High number suggests either acute event (storm) or chronic under-maintenance
reporting_angles: Determine whether spike was caused by recent weather event or reflects years of deferred maintenance by Parks Department
Interview Parks Department about tree removal/remediation timelines and funding availability

themes_detail.label: Safety Complaints Explode
themes_detail.summary: Safety complaints skyrocketed to 3 two weeks ago from a near-zero 0.2 weekly average—a 1100% spike (z-score: 6.35)—representing the single largest percentage increase across all complaint categories and warranting urgent investigation into what type of safety incident(s) triggered this anomaly.
evidence: 3 safety complaints two weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35)—highest percentage increase in dataset
Almost zero baseline means any spike is anomalous; 3 complaints suggests genuine incident cluster
No supporting Reddit discussions or news mentions suggest this may be under-reported locally
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD 107th Precinct to identify what safety incidents drove these complaints two weeks ago
Cross-reference 311 safety complaints with crime statistics, accidents, or structural hazards reported in that timeframe
